row.notes: Casts a vertical ray from pos.y+2.0 to pos.y-2.0 through Ne_PhysWorld_RaycastClosest (world = *(*(*owner+0xd8)+0xe8)+0x20, mask 3). On a miss it retries shifted +0.02 on X, then +0.02 on Z. Writes the hit point (start + dir*fraction) to out_hit, or the input pos if all three miss; returns true only if the first unshifted ray hit. Hook point for wheel-on-tarmac ground probes.
